Definition: from G4862 and G2572; to conceal altogether:--cover.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus says there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed, neither hid that shall not be known. Covering only hides a thing for a season, and the day is coming when every covering comes off.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that nothing stays covered forever, and I believe I should live now as one who will be revealed then.
